dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Numerous light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are present across the mid-dorsal and lateral regions. These features exhibit thin, high-contrast outer perimeters with a sharp gradient transition to the darker base pelage color in their interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters located between larger ring structures, with the highest concentration observed on the lower-left lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form a scalene triangle, while a fourth prominent annulus posterior to this group creates an irregular quadrilateral relationship.
